title: Früher Capability-Spike: Speaches v0.8.3 vs PAR-ASR-001..007 und V4-008
method: Source- and documentation review of Speaches at the pinned tag, faster-whisper/CTranslate2 APIs, Speakr transcription connectors, and clinic-spec JSON catalogs. No Speaches process, GPU job, or labelled German medical audio was run.

engine_pin.release_note: GitHub release v0.8.3 is commit c78b77d (19 Sep). src/speaches/main.py at this commit still advertises FastAPI version 'v0.8.2'.

honest_product_wording_global: Hotword- and prompt biasing is decoder-side context for Whisper, not acoustic training, not a pronunciation lexicon, not speaker adaptation, and not a negative vocabulary. A Speaches/faster-whisper request that returns text after sending prompt or hotwords is not a train_capability proof.

form_fields_confirmed: timestamp_granularities[] (segment|word; word timestamps only with verbose_json)
openai_compatible_batch_stt.local_model_required: 404 if the model is not already installed; download is POST /v1/models/{model_id}, not implicit on transcribe (stt.py get_model_repo_path).

translation.note: Whisper translate-to-English task. Clinic language default is de; this is not German medical dictation.

streaming_file_stt.mechanism: SSE (text/event-stream) when stream=true on the same transcriptions endpoint
streaming_file_stt.note: This streams segments of an already-uploaded file. It is not a microphone session.

realtime.transcription_only_mode: Not present in session.py at this tag. Later Speaches docs describe a transcription-only extension; that is unverified for v0.8.3.

model_management.whisper_filter: Hugging Face models with library ctranslate2 and task automatic-speech-recognition (src/speaches/executors/whisper/utils.py).
model_management.ttl: whisper.ttl default 300s; -1 never unload; 0 unload after use (src/speaches/config.py WhisperConfig).

vad.in_stt: vad_filter form field plus default _unstable_vad_filter=True (Silero via faster-whisper).

language.batch_stt: ISO language code passed to faster-whisper; None = auto-detect first 30s.
language.realtime_default_at_tag: en on an English-only distil model — unsuitable for German medical dictation unless the session is reconfigured.

tts.clinic_relevance: Not a dictation recognition capability. Irrelevant to PAR-ASR-001..007 recognition quality.

not_present_at_this_tag: POST /asr (whisper-asr-webservice) — Speakr ASREndpointConnector cannot talk to Speaches without a new adapter
Any train / adapt / fine-tune / pronunciation / speaker-profile endpoint
Speaker diarization on the STT router (v0.8.3 models.py lists only ASR + TTS registries)
Job queue, wait-timeout, or late-result merge semantics

faster_whisper.vocabulary_biasing: hotwords= is encoded into the decoder prompt after sot_prev (get_prompt). Documented as 'Hotwords/hint phrases to provide the model with. Has no effect if prefix is not None.' Token budget is about max_length/2. This is prompt biasing, not a vocabulary table and not acoustic training (PR #731).
faster_whisper.initial_prompt: Optional text or token ids prepended as previous_tokens for each window. Style and spelling hint only.
faster_whisper.pronunciation: No pronunciation dictionary, no spoken-form / written-form pair, no phoneme editor.
faster_whisper.speaker_or_acoustic_adaptation: None. Weights are frozen CTranslate2 inference graphs.
faster_whisper.offline_finetune_path: README 'Model conversion': convert a Transformers-compatible (including user fine-tuned) Whisper checkpoint with ct2-transformers-converter, then load the CT2 directory. Training itself is outside faster-whisper.

ctranslate2.role: C++/Python inference engine for Transformer models (README: 'efficient inference').
ctranslate2.training: No training or online adaptation API. Workflow is convert-then-infer (ct2-transformers-converter, quantization). Docs: https://opennmt.net/CTranslate2/quickstart.html
ctranslate2.clinic_consequence: A DNS-style correction-to-acoustic-model job cannot run inside Speaches/CT2. An offline Hugging Face fine-tune plus conversion is a separate pipeline, not a Speaches capability, and is not proven here.

speakr_connector_mapping.asr_endpoint: POST {base}/asr (whisper-asr-webservice / WhisperX). Speaches v0.8.3 does not expose /asr.
speakr_connector_mapping.openai_whisper: OpenAI SDK audio.transcriptions.create. Can point at Speaches if base_url is the Speaches server, but today concatenates hotwords into prompt (does not send the Speaches hotwords form field), does not request verbose_json/word timestamps, and applies a 25 MB OpenAI file limit that Speaches does not declare.
speakr_connector_mapping.capabilities_enum: src/services/transcription/base.py already distinguishes HOTWORDS, INITIAL_PROMPT, STREAMING, TIMESTAMPS. STREAMING is not declared on openai_whisper or asr_endpoint.
speakr_connector_mapping.adapter_work: A Speaches-specific connector (or a strict OpenAI-compatible path that forwards language, prompt, hotwords, vad_filter, timestamp_granularities, verbose_json, and stream) is required before PAR-ASR-001 can be claimed against this engine.

requirements.title: Lokale Hintergrundtranskription
requirements.original_clause: Zur Hintergrund-Erkennung markierte Audioaufträge werden in Text plus Korrekturinformationen umgesetzt; Korrektur ist ein nachgelagerter menschlicher Schritt.
requirements.speaches_capability: Batch STT via POST /v1/audio/transcriptions returns text and, with verbose_json, segment and optional word timestamps; VAD can drop silence. Speaches does not mark a dictation as clinically accepted and has no correction workflow.
source_refs: Speakr src/services/transcription/ (job queue exists; /asr connector is the wrong protocol)
requirements.real_proof_requires: Pinned German-capable CT2 model (candidate Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3, revision recorded), CUDA or documented CPU, labelled German medical audio with hashes, Speaches connector using verbose_json timestamps, isolation of defective audio, and a UI state that leaves human review independent of ASR success.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Lokale Hintergrundtranskription mit faster-whisper über Speaches. Zeitbezug sind Whisper-Segmente/Wortalignments, kein DNS-Korrekturprotokoll. Erkennung ist nicht fachliche Abnahme.
unverified: WER/critical-error rate on clinic German medical speech
Exact decode matrix of clinic codecs (dss/philips/webm) through Speaches PyAV at this tag (speech-to-text.md lists audio format as TODO)

requirements.title: Getrennte Online-/Offlineprofile und Quellen
requirements.original_clause: Autoren können für Live- und Hintergrund-Erkennung getrennte Profile für unterschiedliche Aufnahmequellen führen; ohne Trennung kann ein Profil beide Aufgaben bedienen.
requirements.speaches_capability: Each HTTP request can choose model, language, prompt, hotwords and vad_filter. There is no speaker-acoustic profile, no source-device profile, and no engine-side user store. Realtime WS/RTC exists but v0.8.3 session.py hard-defaults to Systran/faster-distil-whisper-small.en language=en plus Kokoro TTS. Speakr already stores per-user/tag/folder language, hotwords, prompt and model as config, not as engine speaker profiles.
source_refs: BT-ASR-002 then: Eine ASR-Engine ohne Sprecherprofile wird als solche ausgewiesen
requirements.real_proof_requires: Author+source+mode profile records in Speakr that actually change the Speaches request (model id, language=de, prompt/hotwords, live vs batch endpoint); a live path using a German multilingual model rather than the English distil default; explicit UI copy that Speaches has no acoustic speaker profile; restart of a second workstation loading the same config.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Profile sind Konfiguration (Modell, Sprache, Prompt/Hotwords, Live- vs Batch-Endpunkt) pro Autor, Quelle und Modus. Speaches hat keine sprecherakustischen DNS-Profile. Eine Engine ohne Sprecherprofile wird so ausgewiesen.
unverified: Whether Speaches realtime at this tag can be configured into a stable German transcription-only session (transcription-only is not in session.py)
Live latency/quality on Philips 9600/9620 vs browser mic

requirements.title: ASR-Wartezeit mit manueller Ersatzbearbeitung
requirements.original_clause: Nach konfigurierbarer maximaler Wartezeit kann Hintergrund-Erkennung übersprungen und manuelle Abschrift angeboten werden.
requirements.speaches_capability: None. Batch STT is a synchronous HTTP call; Speaches has no recognition job queue, wait policy, or late-result merge. Timeout, skip-to-manual, and never-overwrite of a human revision are Speakr application semantics (ASR_TIMEOUT / job queue exist; the late-ASR vs manual-revision contract is not implemented as a clinic gate).
source_refs: stt.py transcribe_file (sync, optional SSE of segments)
09_asr.json explicit_new_contract: Verspätete Erkennung darf bestätigte manuelle Textversion nicht überschreiben
requirements.real_proof_requires: Configurable wait, skip-to-manual UI, disabled-timeout behaviour, and a replay of a late Speaches response against an already-edited revision showing no overwrite. GPU/model optional for this test; a blocked worker plus labelled or synthetic audio is enough, plus clock control.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Wartezeit und manuelle Ersatzbearbeitung sind Produktlogik vor der Engine. Speaches liefert keine Job-Frist.
unverified: Current Speakr processing job behaviour when ASR_TIMEOUT fires versus a late HTTP completion

requirements.title: Optimierung aus geprüfter Korrektur
requirements.original_clause: Fertigstellung kann geprüften Text oder Text+Audio zur Verbesserung von Wortschatz/Sprach-/Akustikmodell verwenden; Text+Audio verlangt vollständige Übereinstimmung.
requirements.speaches_capability: No train, adapt, or pronunciation endpoint. faster-whisper hotwords/initial_prompt only inject decoder prompt tokens. CTranslate2 is inference-only; a separate Hugging Face Whisper fine-tune can later be converted with ct2-transformers-converter, which is not a Speaches job and is not correction-driven acoustic adaptation.
source_refs: No matching router under src/speaches/routers at c78b77d
CTranslate2 README: efficient inference; converters, no trainer
requirements PAR-ASR-004 implementation_rule; V4-008; X4-013; WB-018; decisions D44
requirements.real_proof_requires: If the gap stays: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE on train/pronunciation UI, no dummy success, no prompt stored as a model artefact (X4-013, WB-018). If an offline fine-tune is later proposed: GPU, labelled aligned German medical audio+text pairs with documented consent, a new CT2 artefact with eval WER vs baseline, and a versioned model id — still not Speaches-native and not this spike.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Speaches/faster-whisper lernen nicht aus Korrekturen. Hotword- und Prompt-Biasing ist kein akustisches Training, kein Sprachmodell-Update und kein Aussprachetraining. train_capability ist false.
unverified: Whether a clinic-legal offline Whisper fine-tune would beat prompt/hotword biasing on the future labelled set — no corpus exists in this spike

requirements.title: Optimierungsfenster und Mindestdatenmenge
requirements.original_clause: Zeitfenster können aufwendige Modelloptimierungen begrenzen; akustische Daten können gesammelt werden, bis genügend Material vorliegt.
requirements.speaches_capability: None. There is no optimisation job type, no waiting_data state, and no minimum-audio policy in Speaches. A Speakr scheduler around a non-existent train job would still be a gap, not a windowed optimisation.
source_refs: Speaches routers at c78b77d (stt, speech, vad, models, realtime, chat, misc only)
09_asr.json open_question: Handbuch nennt unter 180 Sekunden als nicht sinnvoll, nicht universell harte Untergrenze
requirements.real_proof_requires: Either keep CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (insufficient data must not report succeeded), or a real local training pipeline with a documented minimum duration, a clock-bounded window, and parallel recognition jobs that stay a different job class. GPU plus labelled German medical audio only matter if that pipeline exists.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Es gibt kein Optimierungsfenster, weil es keinen Optimierungsjob gibt. Hotword-Listen nachts umzuschreiben ist kein Modelltraining.

requirements.title: Profil-Speicherung und Arbeitsstationswechsel
requirements.original_clause: Profiländerungen lassen sich nie/nach Rückfrage/immer speichern und optional zentral hinterlegen; ein neuer Arbeitsplatz kann den gespeicherten Stand laden.
requirements.speaches_capability: No profile persistence. Model files live in the Hugging Face cache of the Speaches host; request options are stateless. Never/ask/always save, central versioning, and second-workstation load are Speakr identity/config work around prompt, hotwords, language, model id — not engine speaker profiles.
requirements.real_proof_requires: Persist never/ask/always for clinic ASR config (model, language, prompt/hotwords, live vs batch). Load the same versioned record on a second browser/workstation. Conflict UI. No biometric speaker identification. Disclose that the portable artefact is configuration, not a Dragon user acoustic profile.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Gespeicherte Profile sind zentrale Konfiguration (Modell, Sprache, Hinweise). Sie sind kein mitgeführtes Akustikmodell und keine biometrische Sprecheridentifikation.
unverified: Conflict behaviour of current Speakr user settings across two sessions

requirements.title: Diktierquelle und Versand-Audioformat
requirements.original_clause: Quelle kann während Sitzung gewechselt oder beim Start vorgegeben werden; für Versand ist Standardaudio oder unterstützte Kompression wählbar.
requirements.speaches_capability: Speaches accepts a multipart audio file and decodes it (faster-whisper/PyAV). It is not a capture-source switcher and not the clinic send/export path. Speakr already converts uploads with ffmpeg (AUDIO_CODEC/BITRATE) and can refuse unsupported codecs; source change is web recorder or import-agent work.
source_refs: docs/usage/speech-to-text.md (audio format still TODO at this tag)
speech.py TTS formats mp3/flac/wav/pcm are synthesis, not dictation send
requirements.real_proof_requires: Two real sources (e.g. Philips device via import-agent and browser mic), confirmed segment boundary on source change, ffmpeg-probed export of a declared codec that plays, and rejection of an unsupported format without extension relabel. Speaches need only transcribe the resulting PCM/file; codec claims must be probed, not inferred.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Quellenwechsel und Versandcodec sind Aufnahme- und Exportfunktionen der Anwendung. Speaches transkribiert gelieferte Audiodateien; es definiert den Versandcodec nicht.
unverified: Which clinic containers Speaches PyAV actually decodes at v0.8.3
dss-codec round-trip (S00 pin still unresolved in upstream-lock.json)

requirements.title: Echte ASR-Fähigkeiten
requirements.original_clause: Capabilities aus realen Prüfungen, explizite Profil-/Lexikon-/Trainingssemantik; kein Hotwordprompt als Ersatz für akustische Optimierung.
requirements.speaches_capability: This source review is the first capability inventory. Confirmed: batch STT, language, prompt, hotwords, VAD, word timestamps, model download/TTL, file SSE streaming, realtime WS/RTC (English TTS session defaults), TTS. Confirmed absent: acoustic training, pronunciation training, negative lexicon engine effect, speaker-acoustic profiles. Speakr already has a HOTWORDS/INITIAL_PROMPT capability enum; clinic defaults set training_mode=capability_gated and training_ui_without_capability_forbidden=true.
source_refs: PAR-VOC-003 implementation_rule: Prompt oder Ergebnis-nachträglich-löschen ist kein harter Lexikonausschluss
PAR-VOC-007: Keine Behauptung dass Vorlesen Training sei
requirements.real_proof_requires: Runtime capability flags from a live Speaches v0.8.3 probe (not this JSON). Training/pronunciation/negative-lexicon actions must return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Hotword effect on labelled German medical terms must be measured and labelled biasing, never training. X4-014 needs a real recording after profile reload; UI storage alone is not a pass.
requirements.honest_product_wording: Fähigkeiten sind die dieser Spike-Tabelle, nicht die DNS-Handbuchseite. Hotword-/Prompt-Biasing ist kein akustisches Training. train_capability bleibt false, bis ein unabhängiger, evaluierter Modellartefakt-Job existiert.
unverified: Measured hotword lift on German medical terms
Negative-lexicon engine effect (not offered by Speaches; cannot pass X4-014 against this engine)
Realtime German transcription-only session at this tag

related_vocabulary_gaps_not_in_p10_scope.note: Negative word list has no Speaches/faster-whisper API. Prompt omission or post-filtering is not a hard lexicon exclusion (implementation_rule). X4-014 cannot pass against this engine without a different ASR.
No pronunciation training or phonetic editor. TTS playback of a spelling is not training.

open_gaps: Acoustic / language-model adaptation from reviewed corrections (PAR-ASR-004/005) — Speaches and CT2 cannot do this.
Speaker-acoustic profiles (DNS user profile) — disclose absence; config profiles only.
Speakr /asr connector vs Speaches /v1/audio/transcriptions protocol mismatch.
Realtime default at v0.8.3 is English distil-whisper + Kokoro TTS, not German transcription-only.
No labelled German medical corpus, no GPU run, no WER in this spike.
clinic-spec markdown docs 14 and grok 11_ASR_Qualitaetsplan were not on disk in this worktree.

proposed_regression_benchmark_outline.truthfulness: Fixtures and this spike do not pass hardware, model, or medical quality.
proposed_regression_benchmark_outline.engine_pin: speaches v0.8.3 c78b77d + recorded faster-whisper/CT2 versions + model id/revision

minimum_cases_when_lab_exists.content: Approved German medical dictation phrases including clinic proper names; no unapproved real patient audio

conditions: baseline: language=de, no prompt, no hotwords, vad_filter documented
hotword_bias: same audio with clinic lexicon in hotwords and/or prompt — report as biasing, never as training
bad_audio: truncated/silent file must isolate, not fail the queue
timeout_manual: blocked worker, skip-to-manual, late result must not overwrite
metrics: critical errors by category (negation, dosage, names, laterality) raw vs after human correction
active correction seconds per audio minute
hotword lift vs baseline (delta WER on targeted terms only)
